offering_description.value: Builds and rehabilitates roads, highways, bridges, dams, water and utility infrastructure, and mass transit for public and private owners. Also mines aggregates and produces asphalt and ready-mix concrete through its own materials plants, used in its projects and sold to others.

primary_services.value: heavy civil construction; highway and bridge construction; site development; construction management; design-build contracting

customer_segment.value: B2G: state departments of transportation, municipalities, transit agencies, water authorities, federal agencies; B2B: private developers, utilities, industrial and commercial owners, contractors buying materials

end_markets.value: transportation infrastructure; water and wastewater; public works; commercial and industrial development; energy and utilities

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price, unit-price and cost-plus construction contracts; product sales: aggregates, asphalt and concrete sold to third parties

value_chain_position.value: service provider: construction contractor buying labor, equipment and materials, serving public agencies and private owners; raw materials: mines aggregates and produces asphalt and concrete from owned quarries and plants

geography_served.value: US national: Concentrated in California, plus Western states, Florida, Texas and other US regions

specialization.value: related lines: infrastructure construction and construction materials production

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive public bidding and negotiated contracts with agencies and owners; own locations: company quarries and asphalt and concrete plants selling materials directly

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Public procurement rules, contractor licensing, environmental, mining and workplace safety rules (OSHA, MSHA, EPA)
